entries.answer: guest/guest only gets MXSE.candles; book/trades/openInterest require a MOEX license key. REST boardprice.json (depth=5) works without auth.

entries.query: M08 robot detection in REST mode
entries.answer: REST polling injects one synthetic trade per poll, so trade_gaps = poll interval (5s) + jitter. CV threshold 0.25 must be relaxed or data comes from candles begin/end for true inter-trade gaps.
